x_1577958_dsb_pattern.name: Telecommunications service and order management
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.overview: Inventory, assurance, then orders. (1) CSM foundation for accounts, contacts, sites and sold products. (2) Service inventory (customer-facing services) related to network inventory — populated from OSS/inventory systems via Service Graph / IntegrationHub, not manual entry. (3) Network events into Event Management; network incidents with impacted services and accounts calculated from inventory relationships. (4) Proactive notification and case linkage for impacted accounts. (5) Product catalogue and Order Management: product offerings, specifications, order decomposition and orchestration to OSS/BSS. (6) eBonding with partners using OOB/IntegrationHub patterns. (7) Assurance and order dashboards. Table names for the telecom apps vary by release — confirm with evidence tel.apps before configuration.
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.pain: Agents cannot see which customer services are affected by a network fault Orders stall across OSS/BSS hand-offs B2B customers learn of outages before the provider tells them Duplicate product definitions in several systems Manual ticket exchange with wholesale partners
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.summary: A telecommunications provider runs customer service, order fulfilment and network assurance in separate OSS/BSS tools. Agents cannot see network impact on a customer's services, orders stall between systems, and B2B customers receive late outage information. The pattern converges on ServiceNow Telecommunications Service Management and Order Management (where licensed) on the CSM foundation: a product and service catalogue, customer-facing service inventory linked to network inventory, order decomposition and orchestration to OSS, and proactive service impact from network events to customer cases.
